title: Existing house and addition: disputed engineer repair scope
jurisdiction: Saskatchewan; municipality redacted in the published decision

facts.text: A December 2024 order referred to an engineer report dated 2023-08-04 and required either completion of its structural work or a new Saskatchewan-licensed engineer report proposing an alternative means of structural integrity.
The appeal exhibit list names a sketch of proposed work, plan-examination report, engineering reports, photos, permit records, and correspondence.
The applicant described an existing house/addition, a leaning wall, temporary wood supports, disagreement with the original repair scope, and a second engineer visit scheduled for 2025-02-07.
